title: buteraea foetidissima
intro: Buteraea foetidissima, commonly known as "Skunkbush", is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, known for its strong, unpleasant odor. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Buteraea foetidissima include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which make it effective in treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
